usage.heading: Bot Chat

settings.title: Settings
settings.reduceMotionHint: Static avatars; the status stays written out. The macOS setting applies too.
settings.dictationLanguageHint: The language the Mac listens for when you dictate
settings.cavemanHint: Bots answer you in 1 to 3 lines: the result, then what you need to decide. For the messages you send from here; what they write elsewhere stays normal.

guide.title: Chat guide
guide.mention: Mention another bot in the message
guide.model: Change the model of this conversation
guide.brain: Think it through together, nothing runs
guide.plan: Build a plan before anything runs
guide.delivery: While a bot works: keep a draft, queue it, or interrupt
guide.files: Add files: drag and drop, paste, or the + button
guide.mic: Dictate with the Mac’s speech recognition: Stop to edit the text, Send to send it at once
guide.quote: Quote the selected text in the composer

settings.freeModeHint: The picker offers only what costs nothing more: free models (Gemini with an AI Studio key without billing, NVIDIA, OpenRouter’s :free models, local models) and your subscriptions’ models, marked below. A bot’s current model stays listed, marked Paid. On this Mac, at once.
settings.modelsNote: Choose which models appear in the picker, for all bots and in every HermesBot app (Mac and iPhone), then Save. The active model and the profile’s model are always offered.
settings.modelsSaveFailed: Could not save: the gateway is not answering. Your changes stay here; try again.
settings.modelsDiscardConfirm: Close without saving your model changes?
settings.sessionHint: Forgets the credentials saved on this Mac
settings.notificationsTestHint: Sends one now, like a bot that is done
settings.notificationsTestBody: Notifications work: this is how a bot tells you it is done.

notificationsTestResult.shown: Sent. Nothing on screen? Check System Settings > Notifications > HermesBot, and your Focus.
notificationsTestResult.failed: Refused: notifications are off for HermesBot in System Settings > Notifications.
notificationsTestResult.silent: No answer from macOS: this build of the app isn’t signed, so macOS drops its notifications.

settings.notificationsHint: When a bot is done or waits on your answer, unless its chat is in view

vault.removeConfirm: Remove the credentials for {{host}} from the bots machine’s keychain?
vault.note: Credentials the bots use in the shared Chrome. They are stored in the login keychain of the bots machine, visible in Keychain Access. The vault types the password itself: the bot never sees it.
vault.empty: No credentials yet. A bot that needs to sign in will ask you in a window.
vault.shareCredentialsHint: A login given to one bot serves them all: before asking you for a login, each bot finds the ones already stored. Off, each credential stays reserved for the bots chosen for it.
vault.autoSignupHint: When a bot needs to create an account, the vault generates the password, fills it in and stores it without a card; you are told afterwards. Requests for credentials and codes keep their card. Never in a scheduled task.

models.freeModeOn: Free mode: free and subscription models only.

serverRequest.checkSite: Make sure this is the right site before continuing.
serverRequest.credentialsNote: Saved in Hermes’s local vault, tied to this site. The bot never sees the password.
serverRequest.unlockBody: {{bot}} needs to use a login saved in {{name}}.
serverRequest.unlockNote: Valid for this session only. The bot never sees this password.
serverRequest.codeHint: {{bot}} is waiting for the code sent to your phone or by email.

ask.signup: A new account, password generated by the vault

vaultSso.noPasswordField: The page shows no password field.
vaultSso.accountPage: This is the {{provider}} account sign-in page itself ({{host}}): the username and password asked for are those of your {{provider}} account.
vaultSso.question: No password for this site?
vaultSso.buttonTitle: The bot will click the site’s “Continue with {{provider}}” button, without a password. Nothing is stored.
vaultSso.steerFailed: Request declined, but {{bot}} didn’t get the reason ({{provider}}): tell them in the chat to click “Continue with {{provider}}”.

errors.request_busy: This request is already in progress.
errors.origin_mismatch: The site shown has changed. Fill-in refused.
errors.origin_not_found: No credentials saved for this site.
errors.vault_unavailable: The bots machine’s keychain is unreachable.
errors.vault_write_failed: The bots machine’s keychain refused the write.
errors.vault_service_unavailable: The bots machine’s vault isn’t responding. From another Mac, ↻ restarts the tunnel.
errors.admin_forbidden: The bots machine’s vault rejects the app: token missing. From another Mac, ↻ fetches it.
errors.user_session_required: Hermes session expired: sign in again to edit the vault.
errors.entry_exists: Credentials are already saved for this site. The bot should use fill, or remove the old ones in Settings > Vault.
errors.settings_write_failed: The vault could not save the setting.

browserVault.bodySave: Check the site shown in the bots’ Chrome.
browserVault.bodyCode: The code is entered straight into the page, without going through the bot.
browserVault.noteSave: Stored in the bots machine’s keychain, reserved for {{bot}}. Never sent to Hermes, the gateway or the bot.
browserVault.noteSaveReplace: This replaces the saved password for {{identifier}} and adds {{bot}} to the bots allowed ({{bots}}). Stored in the bots machine’s keychain, never sent to Hermes, the gateway or the bot.
browserVault.noteCode: No code stays in the chat or the logs.
browserVault.ariaSignup: Create an account on a site
browserVault.bodySignup: {{bot}} wants to create an account on {{origin}} with {{identifier}}. A strong password will be generated, filled in and saved in the vault; it will never go through the chat.
browserVault.noteSignup: Stored in the bots machine’s keychain, reserved for {{bot}}. You’ll find it in Settings > Vault.
